links.outcome: LLM preservation of diagnostic uncertainty cues across five levels in clinical text revision
links.effect: LLMs preserved original uncertainty cues poorly, often less than half the time, and struggled to distinguish adjacent uncertainty levels.
links.quote: Our results show that (1) LLMs preserve the original uncertainty cues poorly, often less than half the time; (2) LLMs struggle with nuanced distinctions between adjacent levels.

unlisted_practices: Benchmarking LLM preservation of diagnostic uncertainty expressions in clinical text summarization and revision

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM performance on preserving diagnostic uncertainty cues in clinical text summarization/revision, identifying a clinically relevant safety failure mode.
